name: Support Vector Machine (SVM)
when_to_use: Binary classification (or multiclass via extension) with a not necessarily linear boundary between classes (kernel); seeks the maximum separation margin between groups.
notes: Finds the "dividing line" that separates two classes with the largest possible safety margin. Applications: binary classification with a non-obvious boundary between groups.

expected_input.question: What is the boundary that separates two classes with the largest possible safety margin?

plain_explanation.purpose: Finds the boundary that best separates two classes, with the most room possible.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When there are two classes and many factors, with a medium dataset.
plain_explanation.data_needed: Numeric factor columns and a response with two classes.
plain_explanation.diagram: class A  ooo | line with margin | xxx  class B
